semiconductor_relevance: High — SCIL Nanoimprint specializes in advanced lithography technology that is crucial for the manufacturing of semiconductor devices.
summary: SCIL Nanoimprint provides mass-production-ready nanoimprint lithography solutions for forming nanostructures on large-diameter wafers. Their technology enables improved performance and reduced costs in the production of various optical and semiconductor devices.
capabilities: Substrate Conformal Imprint Lithography (SCIL) for nano-patterning
High-precision alignment with overlay alignment down to 100 nm (inferred)
Mass production solutions for optical and semiconductor devices
Optimized equipment consumable materials for high volume production
